ellipsised down to a fragment. Before the directed-occlusion pass and the
horizontal arm of text_fits_container, BOTH of these snapshots analysed
terminal-zone-minimap  z=30, parked over the right end of a z=10 tile
header -> a directed `occlusion` finding naming the
minimap as occluder and quoting the hidden text.
cannot see it -- that is the point.
zone-8-card            z=0, the header's own container. Fully overlapped
by both, and must NOT be reported: it is under
them by ordinary nesting, and `occlusion` is only
about what is HIDDEN from the reader.
truncated-session-name 160px of text in an 80px box -> text_fits_container
must FAIL horizontally even though the box is tall
enough for the font (the vertical arm passes).
